fire_drill_participants_source_reference.name: fire_drill_participants_source_reference_check
fire_drill_participants_source_reference.value: ("fire_drill_participants"."participant_source" = 'roster' and "fire_drill_participants"."resident_id" is not null) or ("fire_drill_participants"."participant_source" in ('manual', 'external') and "fire_drill_participants"."resident_id" is null)

fire_drill_participants_duration_check.name: fire_drill_participants_duration_check
fire_drill_participants_duration_check.value: ("fire_drill_participants"."duration_minutes" is not null and "fire_drill_participants"."duration_minutes" between 0 and 2147483647 and "fire_drill_participants"."duration_seconds" between 0 and 59) or ("fire_drill_participants"."duration_minutes" is null and "fire_drill_participants"."duration_seconds" is null and coalesce(length(btrim("fire_drill_participants"."comment")), 0) > 0)

fire_drill_reports_drill_type_identity_c.name: fire_drill_reports_drill_type_identity_check
fire_drill_reports_drill_type_identity_c.value: ("fire_drill_reports"."drill_type" = 'scheduled' and "fire_drill_reports"."sequence" is not null and "fire_drill_reports"."admission_resident_id" is null and "fire_drill_reports"."admission_resident_name_snapshot" is null) or ("fire_drill_reports"."drill_type" = 'admission' and "fire_drill_reports"."sequence" is null and coalesce(length(btrim("fire_drill_reports"."admission_resident_name_snapshot")), 0) > 0)

fire_drill_reports_staff_names_check.name: fire_drill_reports_staff_names_check
fire_drill_reports_staff_names_check.value: case when jsonb_typeof("fire_drill_reports"."staff_names") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("fire_drill_reports"."staff_names") between 1 and 24 and not jsonb_path_exists("fire_drill_reports"."staff_names", '$[*] ? (@.type() != "string" || @ == "")') else false end

fire_drill_reports_void_check.name: fire_drill_reports_void_check
